modules.title: Introduction to Suna (Nouns)
modules.html:
Types of Hausa nouns, gender and number. This section covers introduction to suna (nouns).

Key points

  • Wanne ne cikin wadannan wakilin suna ne na nuni (Demonstrative Pronoun) — Wannan.
  • A wanne lokaci ne ake cin 'Tuwon Suna' — Naming Ceremony.
  • A wanne lokaci ne ake yin 'Tuwon Suna' — Lokacin radin suna.
  • Wanne ne 'Suna' a cikin wannan jumlar: 'Audu ya tafi kasuwa' — Audu.
  • Menene ake kira da 'Bikin Suna' — Naming Ceremony.

Worked examples

Q: Wanne ne cikin wadannan wakilin suna ne na nuni (Demonstrative Pronoun)?
A: Wannan — 'Wannan' (this) is used for pointing or indicating a specific noun, making it a demonstrative pronoun.

Q: A wanne lokaci ne ake cin 'Tuwon Suna'?
A: Naming Ceremony — 'Tuwon Suna' is the special meal prepared during a naming ceremony.

A wanne lokaci ne ake cin 'Tuwon Suna'?

quiz.q: Wanne ne cikin wadannan wakilin suna ne na nuni (Demonstrative Pronoun)?
quiz.solution: 'Wannan' (this) is used for pointing or indicating a specific noun, making it a demonstrative pronoun.

quiz.q: A wanne lokaci ne ake cin 'Tuwon Suna'?
quiz.solution: 'Tuwon Suna' is the special meal prepared during a naming ceremony.

quiz.q: A wanne lokaci ne ake yin 'Tuwon Suna'?
quiz.solution: Tuwon Suna is a traditional meal prepared during the naming ceremony of a newborn.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Suna' a cikin wannan jumlar: 'Audu ya tafi kasuwa'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Audu.

quiz.q: Menene ake kira da 'Bikin Suna'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Naming Ceremony.

quiz.q: A al'adar Hausa, me ake kira ga taron da ake yi don raɗa wa jariri suna?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Suna.

quiz.q: Wanne littafi ne Sir Abubakar Tafawa Balewa ya rubuta?
quiz.solution: The first Prime Minister of Nigeria, Sir Abubakar Tafawa Balewa, wrote 'Shaihu Umar'.

quiz.q: Menene 'Tatsuniya'?
quiz.solution: Tatsuniya refers to fictional folktales often told to children at night.

quiz.q: Menene 'Labarin zuciya'?
quiz.solution: In metaphorical Hausa, 'Labarin zuciya' refers to one's inner secrets or true feelings.

quiz.q: Cika wannan: ' muna son karatun Hausa.'
quiz.solution: The subject marker 'muna' agrees with the first-person plural pronoun 'Mu' (We).

quiz.q: A ina ake yin sana'ar 'Kira'?
quiz.solution: The blacksmith's workshop is called 'Makera'.

quiz.q: Wacce dabba ce 'Zomo'?
quiz.solution: 'Zomo' is the Hausa word for Rabbit.

quiz.q: Menene 'Adjective'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Sifa.

quiz.q: Menene 'Father'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Baba.

quiz.q: Sana'ar Hausawa:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Dukansu.

quiz.q: Menene 'Sleep'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Bacci.

quiz.q: Menene 'Al'ada'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Culture/Tradition.

quiz.q: A ina ake gudanar da 'Durbar'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Fada (Palace).

quiz.q: Menene 'Sarkin Musulmi'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sultan.

quiz.q: Kalmar 'Sauri' a harshen Hausa tana nufin...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Fast.

quiz.q: Menene sunan abincin da aka fi sani da shi a kasar Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Tuwo da miya.

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar 'Adabi'?
options: Hali ko dabi'a da fasahar magana
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Hali ko dabi'a da fasahar magana.

quiz.q: Sarkin Kano ana ce masa:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Emir.

quiz.q: Mene ne sunan 'Water' da Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ruwa.

quiz.q: Wanne ne ba 'Hausa Bakwai' ba?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Kebbi.

quiz.q: Babban birnin Najeriya shi ne:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Abuja.

quiz.q: Tuwo material:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Masara.

quiz.q: Fura ingredient:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Gero.

quiz.q: Menene 'One'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Daya.
